periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes are oriented at approximately 45 degrees downward and outward from the horizontal midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval blobs with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.6:1 along the dominant axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate tapering visible at the inferior margin, extending the patch significantly below the ocular center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape curve profile at the posterior edge where the band meets the white dorsal fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, occupying approximately 35% of the visible torso height at the lateral flank.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Large gap between pinnae, approximately 2.5 times the horizontal width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: High smoothness with perfectly rounded semicircular apexes.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant chromatic variance between the white cranial fur and the yellowish-brown tint of the ventral/chest fur.
